facts.fact: The Xalam brief says the Senegalese government "has outlined" a Technology New Deal, part of the 2050 national Transformation Agenda, with pillars of digital infrastructure, skills, innovation, public-sector digitization and digital security; it names no adopting act or body, and gives no date, so the brief's published date is used.

The Xalam brief gives an "estimated budget" for the Technology New Deal of around $2bn and a goal of a digital economy at around 15% of GDP by 2034; it describes no action plan, so the cost is a strategy-level estimate and its source is not stated; the brief's published date is used.

note: Strategy named as 'outlined' by the government, no adoption act, no text link, no period stated; no period fact.
